The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Support accurate and timely product inventory management'. Each LLG is documentably supported, non-redundant, and correctly scoped. They include setting reorder thresholds, real-time inventory updates upon receipt, manual replenishment initiation, automatic reorder triggers with confirmation deadlines, and system logging for reorder requests.

The LLGs 'Administrator sets reorder threshold for product' (llg_001), 'System updates inventory in real-time upon product receipt' (llg_002), 'Administrator initiates manual replenishment for product' (llg_003), 'System triggers automatic reorder when inventory reaches threshold' (llg_004), and 'System sends automatic reorder request to supplier with 2-working-day confirmation deadline' (llg_005) all directly address the parent HLG's requirements.

The actor, 'Administrator', is documentably responsible for these actions without requiring manual UI triggers for system operations. The LLGs cover both automatic and manual replenishment methods, real-time inventory tracking, and supplier communication, aligning with the reconstructed HLG'. No essential capabilities are missing or misleadingly represented.
